profile.name: Julabo FP50 恒温循环冷却器
profile.description: Julabo FP50 是一款实验室用恒温循环冷却器，可通过循环液体为外部设备或实验过程提供稳定的冷却与温度控制。它适用于需要维持恒定工作温度的仪器、样品或装置。
profile.description_en: The Julabo FP50 is a laboratory recirculating chiller that provides stable cooling and temperature control to external equipment or experimental processes through circulating fluid. It is used where instruments, samples, or setups need a controlled operating temperature.
